_comment: The achievement catalogue, flattened from the client dump.
Text is a translation key, never a string, for the same reason the quests are:
the editor reads three languages out of the client itself.
objectives.criterion  ALL of an achievement's objectives must hold. Same criterion
language the quests use; the operators that matter here are
OA (another achievement), Qf (a finished quest), PL and SC.
rewards.criterion     one achievement can pay different people differently.
rewards.items         [[itemId, quantity], ...], zipped from the two parallel
arrays the client keeps them in.
Every default value is dropped, so a missing key means zero or empty.
